SC-senate.statusNote: Special election for the seat of Sen. Lindsey Graham, who died July 11. Appointed Sen. Darline Graham defeated Rep. Ralph Norman 53 to 47 in the Aug 25 Republican runoff and is the GOP nominee. Pediatrician Annie Andrews, who won the June 9 Democratic primary with 61.5%, is the Democratic nominee. Kasie Whitener (Libertarian) and Mark Hackett (Constitution Party) are also on the November ballot. Libertarian Kasie Whitener (fec-S6SC04247) confirmed on the Nov 2026 general ballot per WRDW/Live5 coverage of the 4-candidate field; her curated entry keeps the existing fec- id rather than creating a new sc-senate- id. Constitution Party nominee Mark Hackett has no fetchable policy content, all-null entry.

SC-governor.statusNote: Open seat (Gov. McMaster term-limited): Attorney General Alan Wilson (R) won the June 23 runoff with 68.6% over Lt. Gov. Pamela Evette and faces state Rep. Jermaine Johnson (D), who won the June 9 primary with 59.7%. Walid Hakim (Green) and Michael Addison (United Citizens) are also listed for the November ballot. Green nominee Walid Hakim and United Citizens Party nominee Michael Addison added with full curated entries; Hakim's detailed platform page yielded 8 of 10 scored axes, Addison's site had no usable policy content.
